item.title: Synthetic Corp Reports Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Results
item.description: Synthetic Corp (NASDAQ: SYN) today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2026. CEO Alice Example said "We are pleased to report strong Q3 results with revenue growth of 9% year-over-year." CFO Bob Sample stated that diluted earnings per share of $1.55 exceeded guidance range.

item.title: Synthetic Corp Announces New Product Launch
item.description: Synthetic Corp announced the launch of SynAI 2.0. CEO Alice Example said "This represents a major step forward in our AI strategy." The product is expected to launch in Q1 FY2027.

item.title: Synthetic Corp Provides Q4 FY2026 Guidance
item.description: Synthetic Corp provided guidance for Q4 FY2026. The company expects EPS of $1.60 to $1.70 and revenue of $91B to $93B. CFO Bob Sample noted "We are raising guidance based on strong demand trends."
